body.statement: In \(\mathsf E_3\), all realized outcomes are positive, \(q=1\), \(\theta_{\mathrm{PTT}}=1/2\), \(V^{\star}=395643/6246400\), \(\operatorname{Var}(h_{\mathrm{CM}}^{\prime}Z)=6663/102400\), and \(\Gamma=27/15616\); hence the cohort-mean PPML variance exceeds the bound by approximately \(2.73\) percent of \(V^{\star}\).
body.justification: The exact rational witness makes the cohort-mean PPML topology loss quantitatively auditable in the smallest cyclic staggered panel.
body.gap: Published multiplicative DiD examples do not report this PTT-specific canonical bound and exact cycle loss for a legal nonnegative covariance law.
body.consumer: The exhibit provides a reproducible calibration for implementations of the cycle correction.
